items.label: Useful Plants Support
items.value: Qaobo monstera plant support provides a strong support structure for your plants to help make them flourish, assisting your climbing plants to grow vigorously as they gradually climb higher and make them have a beautiful style

items.label: Close to Plants' Color
items.value: To make these plant support stakes more integrated into your daily planting life and not stand out too much in your garden, we use more close to the plant's own color to create plant support, the classic shape makes it has a wider range of scenes of use

items.label: Sturdy Material
items.value: Made of high-quality and excellent plastic material, Qaobo moss pole monstera plant support is odorless and non-corrosive, which can provide strong and long-lasting support for plants to grow higher and stronger, meanwhile with beautiful shape

items.label: Easy to Use
items.value: Can be applied for both indoor and outdoor use, premium material allows plant trellis indoor can be used for various of using scenes, providing sturdy support for different types of leafy or climbing plants, simply insert it into the pot to finish installation

items.label: Wide Use
items.value: The plant climbing support is mainly designed for climbing plants and leafy plants, such as monstera, pothos, philodendron, grape plants etc., to provide strong support for the delicate plant branches, so that it can grow upward and strong

items.label: Recommended Uses for Product
items.value: Support for climbing and leafy plants (e.g. monstera, pothos, philodendron, grape plants), Indoor and outdoor use
